name: temu_seller-mcp
description: Temu Seller Center (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order. Every tool maps

platform_mcp_temu_seller_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_temu_seller_app_key.description: app_key of your TEMU Partner Platform app (partner.temu.com > App management).

platform_mcp_temu_seller_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_temu_seller_app_secret.description: app_secret of the same app; signs every call (upper-case MD5 of app_secret + body parameters sorted by name as name+value + app_secret) and is never sent.

platform_mcp_temu_seller_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_temu_seller_access_token.description: The store's access_token from the Seller Center authorisation (Seller Center > open platform > authorise app, or bg.open.accesstoken.create with the callback code); valid about one year (see expiredTime from me).

platform_mcp_temu_seller_region.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_REGION
platform_mcp_temu_seller_region.description: API host region of the store: us (United States), eu (EU/UK sites) or global (Mexico, Japan, …) → https://openapi-b-<region>.temu.com/openapi/router.

tools.name: me
tools.description: bg.open.accesstoken.info.get: the authorised mall (mallId, regionId, mallType), token expiredTime and the API scopes granted.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: bg.local.goods.list.query (Product > Manage Products): the STORE'S OWN listings on Temu (a seller API, not a wholesale catalogue), status 1 = available/off the shelf; `query` searches goods name or id, `category` is a Temu catId. SKUs (skuId, stock, specs) are in raw.skuInfoList.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: bg.local.goods.detail.query: one listing with skuList (skuId, outSkuSn, specs, retail/list price, images, package weight/volume), properties, size charts and service promise; price/sku are the first SKU's.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: bg.order.detail.v2.get by parent order number (PO-…): parentOrderMap (status code, order/confirm/shipping times in epoch seconds, region) and orderList lines (orderSn, goodsId, skuId, quantity, fulfillmentType, packageSnInfo) in raw. Buyer address needs bg.order.shippinginfo.v2.get / decrypt permissions.
